title: ext/Mention: refs.js auto-syncs its icon, no sync.mjs run needed

set.request: Cheap, never-stale page references. Owner: loading a whole page (or a big page.jsonl) just to get its icon and title is too much; a hand-run cache goes stale; DRY. Today ext/Mention/maps/refs.js is generated by a script someone must re-run (sync.mjs). Make the index rebuild itself: when a page.js's icon/title or a page.jsonl's first line changes, the dev server (it already watches) updates the one index; page.jsonl pages included. Title renames then show everywhere. One index, computed, never typed. Write the decision + the alternative the owner floated (a per-folder meta.json snapshot) in one line on your card.
set.now: proved it live: flipped Sidebar's icon, watched refs.js update, reverted
steps: read sync.mjs, refs.js, watch.js, Directory.js precedent
extract a shared icon-sync function sync.mjs and the watcher both call
build Server/plugins/MentionSync.js on the shared watcher, debounced like Directory.js
prove it: rename a page.js icon live, show refs.js update with no manual script run
update ext/Mention docs (readme + doc/syntax.md) and write the decision
create board card with the one-line decision
set.outcome:
**Landed: `ext/Mention/maps/refs.js`'s icon rebuilds itself.** [`Server/plugins/MentionSync.js`](/framework/servex/fs/?file=Server) sits on the dev server's shared watcher and rewrites a changed icon on its own — proved live by flipping `core/Sidebar/page.js`'s icon and watching `refs.js` update within ~2s, no `sync.mjs` run (`task.jsonl`).

- [x] rebuilds on a page.js/page.jsonl change, no manual script
- [x] page.jsonl pages included (icon borrowed from their own template page)
- [x] decision + the owner's alternative written down: a computed index on the shared watcher, not a per-folder `meta.json` snapshot (one index, one shape — Law 6)
- [ ] `class_card` stays manual (`sync.mjs`) — too expensive per keystroke; `live()` covers the common case

Docs: [`ext/Mention`](/framework/ext/Mention/) readme + [`doc/syntax.md`](/framework/ext/Mention/md/doc/syntax/). Review: pass (no page/layout touched).
